name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: Related pressed controls with single or multiple selection, joined or separated surfaces and logical keyboard navigation.
example:
<ToggleGroup aria-label="Text formatting" selectionMode="multiple"
  selectedKeys={formatting} onSelectionChange={setFormatting}>
  <Toggle id="bold" aria-label="Bold" iconOnly><RiBold aria-hidden /></Toggle>
  <Toggle id="italic" aria-label="Italic" iconOnly><RiItalic aria-hidden /></Toggle>
</ToggleGroup>
